title: Finite etale generators and bounded-above constructible resolutions
statement:
Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme, meaning a quasi-compact scheme with an affine open cover by spectra of rings whose ideals satisfy the ascending chain condition, and let $A$ be a finite commutative ring. Work with sheaves of $A$-modules on its small etale site and their derived category [def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves, def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. Write $D^-_c(X,A)$ for complexes with constructible cohomology, vanishing in sufficiently large degrees [def-weil-pbc-constructible-complexes]. Every constructible sheaf $C$ is Noetherian (its subobjects satisfy the ascending chain condition), and every epimorphism $M\to C$ admits a morphism $u_!A_U\to M$ whose composite onto $C$ is an epimorphism, for a separated etale finite-type map $u:U\to X$ (a finite disjoint union is allowed). Here $u_!$ is etale extension by zero [def-weil-pbc-etale-sum-extension]. Every $L\in D^-_c(X,A)$ with $\mathcal H^i(L)=0$ for $i>0$ has a representative $Q^\bullet$ concentrated in degrees $\leq0$ in which each term is a finite direct sum of such $u_!A_U$ and the kernels and cokernels of its differentials are constructible. In particular one can arrange $Q^0=u_!A_U$ and has the triangle
$$Q^0\longrightarrow L\longrightarrow \sigma^{\leq-1}Q^\bullet\longrightarrow Q^0[1],$$
where $\sigma^{\leq-1}$ is the brutal truncation, so its cohomology vanishes in positive and zero degrees. No finite projective resolution or finite Tor dimension of $C$ is asserted.
